## Purpose
Mistral connectors: MCP servers registered with Mistral, which holds their credentials and runs their tools. These routes register, read, update and delete them, list and test their tools, handle OAuth and credentials (including credentials taken from the vault), and switch them on or off.

## Responsibilities
| Endpoint | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `GET /connectors?page_size=200&cursor=` | every connector visible to the key, directory connectors included |
| `GET /connectors/{id}` | by id or name |
| `POST /connectors` | `CreateConnectorRequest{name (alphanumeric, `-`/`_`, ≤64), description, server (MCP URL), icon_url, system_prompt, visibility shared_org/shared_workspace/private, headers, auth_data{client_id, client_secret}}` |
| `PATCH /connectors/{id}` | `{name, description, icon_url, system_prompt, connection_config}` |
| `DELETE /connectors/{id}` | delete, then add `graph: forget_in_graph("connector", id)` unless the result has an error |
| `GET /connectors/{id}/tools` | `{tools, count}` |
| `POST /connectors/{id}/tools/{tool}/call` | body `{arguments, credentials_name}`; returns `{result, output: flatten_tool_result(result)}` (the UI's test action) |
| `GET /connectors/{id}/authentication` | the auth methods |
| `GET /connectors/{id}/auth-url?credentials_name=` | starts an OAuth2 flow; the URL expires, so the UI fetches it on demand |
| `GET /connectors/{id}/credentials?scope=user` | `{credentials, scope, count}`; scope is organization, workspace or user |
| `POST /connectors/{id}/credentials?scope=user` | `CredentialsRequest{name="default", credentials, is_default=True, vault_fields{field: vault ref}}` |
| `DELETE /connectors/{id}/credentials?scope=&credentials_name=` | delete one named credential, or all of them |
| `POST /connectors/{id}/activation?scope=organization` | `ActivationRequest{active, include, exclude, requires_confirmation, skip_confirmation}`, passed as `tool_configuration` |

## Key elements
- **`_from_vault(connector_id, fields)`:**
  1. Resolves each referenced vault entry to its name.
  2. Calls `vault.resolve(names, consumer="connector:<id>", actor="user")`.
  3. A missing value raises `ValueError("Vault could not supply NAME (reason), …")`, which becomes 422. An unknown entry raises `LookupError`, which becomes 404.
  4. Runs in `to_thread`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
Calls Mistral's connectors API through `services/connector_service.py`, and writes vault usage audit events.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Route policy: connectors.view for GET and connectors.manage for writes.
- Kept deliberately separate from `/api/mcp/*` in tools.py, which drives the Tool Service's own MCP registry. The two registries share no state.

## Error handling and edge cases
Service errors propagate. The delete result may carry an `error` key instead of raising.

## Nuances and gotchas
Vault values are resolved on the server, so a credential never passes through the browser.

## How to rebuild this file
The pydantic models and handlers in the table, plus `_from_vault`.

## Tests
`backend/tests/test_connector_routing.py` covers the service side.
